title: 第十七章 传度第十八章 天帝赐福
content_zh:
问心殿内，原本模糊的铜镜却是异常清晰明亮，把周无纪力战煞鬼的战斗清楚呈现出来。
主持至愿负手站在铜镜前，看到周无纪剑光如雨，瞬间斩灭了九只厉鬼，他不由微微点头：“好剑法。”
以修为来说，周无纪才八品层次，不值一提。
敢于迎战众多厉鬼，这份勇气就很不一般。
剑法也很是精湛，甚至有了两分高妙意味。
下院高手虽多，却少有人在剑法上能有所成就。毕竟宗门主修还是炼气之法，是各种道术神通。
至愿感慨道：“不愧是一元的亲传弟子，得了一元剑法精髓。”
他说着也有些遗憾的叹了口气，单以剑法而论，一元称得上冠绝云阳府，可惜了，如此人物居然走火入魔意外故去。
一平道人有些拘谨微微躬身站在一旁，听到主持夸赞周无纪，他脸上也露出两分喜色。
五品经师，那已经云阳府最强者之一，掌握着大量资源。
这位要是觉得无纪人不错，他这个师侄以后的路就能好走很多。
一平道人斟酌着说辞慢慢说道：“无纪在剑道上的确有天赋，这点上和一元师兄很像。他年纪不大，性子却坚韧耐得住寂寞，人也聪明机敏。”
至愿点点头，从无纪的表现来看，一平道人也不算夸大其词。
他说道：“是个可造之材，你来帮他开坛传度。
“不过、他修为还是不够，不能主持藏龙观。”
一平道人急忙点头：“主持说的是。”
哪怕不说张家，四明县的大族有好几位七品高手，无纪剑法虽然精湛，毕竟只是八品。
回到藏龙观，对现在的无纪来说可不是好事。
“先让他在下院修习法术，过段时间我另行安排。”
至愿并不想把周无纪放在下院，下院事务繁忙，很不利于修行。

一平道人连连点头。
周无纪从万鬼地窟出来，就看到一平道人已经等在门口。
他有些意外，他都不知道自己什么时候出来，师叔也不可能一直守在这。
但他转即明白过来，必然是有什么手段能看到万鬼地窟，师叔看到他出来了，这才过来迎接。
幸好他谨慎，并没有再次催发精血吸引煞鬼。
一层这里应该经常清理，鬼的数量有限，也没必要在这上面浪费太多时间精力，更不能表现的太急切。
毕竟对于普通道人来说，杀阴鬼不会获得任何好处……
当着外人的面，一平道人也没说什么，只是夸奖了周无纪两句。
回到飞玄殿，一平道人才说了至愿主持的安排。
“先在下院修习法术，另有安排？”
周无纪听说不能当藏龙观主持，他脸上露出了失望之色。
“飞玄殿清净无事，很适合修行。”
一平道人说道：“至于四明县的事情，你也不需要在意。什么张家方家，有多大胆子敢来下院找你麻烦！”
“嗯嗯，我听师叔的……”周无纪知道师叔是好意，乖巧应是。
“晚上去天帝殿开坛传度，让上兴领着你去浴堂沐浴，回来后不要吃饭，点三支静心香安神定心。”
一平道人交代了一番，他自去天帝殿做开坛的各种布置。
开坛传度是极其重要的仪轨，步骤繁琐，不能出错。
包括各种灵物祭品，使用的祷文都极其讲究。
其中最重要灵文符卷、盟誓金录，都价值高昂。上面的一个字写错了，都要作废重来。
一平道人也没有多少开坛传度的经验，他必须提前做好各种准备。

使用北极天帝殿，也要和殿主做好沟通。
content_en:
In the Wenxin Hall, the originally blurry bronze mirror was extremely clear and bright, clearly showing Zhou Wuji's battle with the evil spirit.
The host Zhiyuan stood in front of the bronze mirror with his hands behind his hands. When he saw Zhou Wuji's sword flashing like rain, instantly killing nine fierce ghosts, he couldn't help but nodded slightly: "Good swordsmanship."
In terms of cultivation, Zhou Wuji was only at the eighth level, which was not worth mentioning.
The courage to face so many evil ghosts is extraordinary.
The swordsmanship is also very exquisite, even a bit sublime.
Although there are many masters in the House of Commons, few can achieve success in swordsmanship. After all, the sect's main practice is the method of refining qi, which is various Taoist and magical powers.
Zhiyuan sighed with emotion: "As expected of Yiyuan's direct disciple, he has gained the essence of Yiyuan's swordsmanship."
He sighed with regret as he spoke. In terms of swordsmanship alone, Yi Yuan was the best in the Yunyang Mansion. It was a pity that such a person went crazy and died unexpectedly.
Taoist Yiping stood aside with a slight bow and some restraint. Hearing the host's praise of Zhou Wuji, his face also showed a hint of joy.
The fifth-grade Confucian Master is already one of the strongest people in Yunyang Mansion and controls a large amount of resources.
If this person thinks Wuji is good, his future career as a nephew will be much easier.
Taoist Yiping carefully considered his words and said slowly: "Wuji is indeed talented in swordsmanship. He is very similar to Senior Brother Yiyuan in this regard. He is not old, but his temperament is tough and can endure loneliness, and he is also smart and astute."
Zhiyuan nodded. Judging from Wuji's performance, Taoist Yiping was not exaggerating.
He said: "He is a talented person, you come and help him open a forum to spread his teachings.
“However, his cultivation is still not enough to preside over the Hidden Dragon Temple. "
Taoist Yiping nodded hurriedly: "That's what the host said. "
Not to mention the Zhang family, the wealthy families in Siming County have several seventh-grade masters. Although Wuji's swordsmanship is superb, he is only at the eighth grade after all.
Returning to Hidden Dragon Temple is not a good thing for Wuji now.
"Let him practice magic in the lower courtyard first, and I will make other arrangements later. "
Zhiyuan did not want to put Zhou Wuji in the lower court. The lower court was busy with affairs, which was not conducive to practice.
Taoist Yiping nodded repeatedly.
When Zhou Wuji came out of the Ten Thousand Ghosts Cave, he saw Taoist Yiping waiting at the door.
He was a little surprised. He didn't know when he would come out, and his uncle couldn't stay here all the time.
But he immediately realized that there must be some way to see the Ten Thousand Ghosts Cave. His uncle saw him coming out and came to greet him.
Fortunately, he was cautious and did not trigger the blood essence to attract evil spirits again.
The first floor should be cleaned frequently. The number of ghosts is limited, so there is no need to waste too much time and energy on it, let alone act too eagerly.
After all, for ordinary Taoists, killing ghosts will not gain any benefits...
In front of outsiders, Taoist Yiping didn't say anything, he just praised Zhou Wuji.
Returning to Feixuan Hall, Taoist Yiping made arrangements for Zhiyuan to preside over.
"Practice spells in the lower courtyard first, do you have any other plans? "
Zhou Wuji had a look of disappointment on his face when he heard that he could not be the host of Hidden Dragon Temple.
“Feixuan Hall is clean and peaceful, and is very suitable for practice. "
Taoist Yiping said: "As for the matters in Siming County, you don't need to worry about it. How dare the Zhang family and the Fang family dare to come to the lower house to cause trouble for you! "
"Yeah, I listen to my uncle..." Zhou Wuji knew that his uncle meant well, so he should be obedient.
"Go to the Heavenly Emperor's Hall in the evening to open an altar to preach, and let Shangxing take you to the bathhouse to take a bath. Don't eat when you come back, and light three incense sticks to calm your mind and calm your mind. "
Taoist Yiping explained everything, and he went to the Tiandi Hall to make various arrangements for the opening of the altar.
Opening the altar and delivering the sermon is an extremely important ritual. The steps are cumbersome and cannot be made wrong.
Including various spiritual sacrifices, the prayers used are extremely particular.
Among them, the most important spiritual talismans and the golden record of alliance oaths are of high value. If you write a wrong word on it, you will have to invalidate it and start over.
Taoist Yiping doesn't have much experience in opening forums to preach. He must firstMake all preparations beforehand.
When using the Arctic Heavenly Emperor Palace, you must also communicate well with the palace owner.
